name: Nanjing Wavelength Opto-Electronic Science & Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Wavelength Opto-Electronic Science & Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, production, and sale of precision optical components in China. The company offers laser optical series; laser processing tools, including spot laser cleaning head, 20-spot pulsed laser cleaning head, high-speed splitter box, fiber optic collimator, laser welding head, laser cladding head, dual-band composite welding joints, solar cell partitioning, and high-power galvanometer welding head; and D30 laser foreign object removal, d52 laser foreign object removal, and laser remote system lens.
